script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

Title: FRESH STARTS

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

*JULIA, mid-30s, sits at a small table, staring at the steaming cup of coffee in front of her.*

WAITRESS (O.S.)
(cheerfully)
Another one bites the dust?

JULIA
(laughs)
You could say that.

INT. JULIA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

*Julia sits on the couch, surrounded by boxes. She sighs, looking at the pile of unwanted belongings.*

JULIA
(to herself)
I can't believe I'm doing this again.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

*Julia enters the kitchen of her new apartment, carrying a box of dishes. She sets them down on the counter and looks around, taking in the unfamiliar surroundings.*

JULIA
(to herself)
Well, here goes nothing.

Suddenly, a knock on the door. Julia looks surprised but opens it to find her neighbor, MARK, a friendly, middle-aged man.

MARK
(smiling)
Hey, I'm Mark. I live next door. Welcome to the building!

JULIA
(smiling back)
Nice to meet you, Mark. I'm Julia.

MARK
(looking around)
Moving in?

JULIA
(nods)
Yeah, I just got a new job here in the city.

MARK
(sympathetic)
I'm so sorry about your husband.

JULIA
(surprised)
Oh, no. We're not divorced. He passed away last year.

MARK
(sincerely)
I'm really sorry for your loss. But I hope this new job and fresh start will help you move on.

JULIA
(smiling)
Thank you, Mark. I appreciate your kindness.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

*Julia enters her new office and meets her colleagues, PETER and SARAH. They are all friendly and welcoming.*

PETER
(extending a hand)
Hi, I'm Peter. You must be Julia, our new marketing manager.

JULIA
(shaking his hand)
Nice to meet you, Peter.

SARAH
(smiling)
And I'm Sarah. We're the sales team.

JULIA
(smiling back)
Nice to meet you, Sarah.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

*Julia and Mark sit at a table, laughing over coffee. They've become good friends in the short time since she moved in.*

MARK
(grinning)
So, what do you think of the job so far?

JULIA
(smiling)
I love it. The people are great, and I'm learning so much.

MARK
(nodding)
I'm glad to hear that. I knew this company would be a good fit for you.

JULIA
(serious)
Thank you, Mark. Your belief in me means a lot.

MARK
(smiling)
Believe in yourself, Julia. You've got this.

INT. APARTMENT BUILDING LOBBY - NIGHT

*Julia enters the lobby, dressed up for a dinner party at Mark's apartment. She runs into PETER, who is also headed to the party.*

PETER
(surprised)
Hey, Julia. Fancy seeing you here.

JULIA
(smiling)
Hi, Peter. Yes, I'm going to the dinner party at Mark's.

PETER
(awkwardly)
Oh, right. I didn't realize you knew Mark.

JULIA
(smiling)
Yes, we've become good friends. He's a great neighbor.

PETER
(smiling back)
I'm glad to hear that. See you at the party.

INT. MARK'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

*Julia and Peter arrive at Mark's apartment, where they join other colleagues and their spouses. They all mingle and enjoy the evening, and Julia is grateful for the second chance at making new friends.*

JULIA
(to herself)
I'm so glad I took this job. And I'm even happier to have met Mark.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
